_doc: Intake trial (B64 decision 7): 40 invented mails, none real, each with the class the intake desk must give it. Classes follow the page's decision 12: is = work for an owner; onemli = not work, a real person or an official body on a real matter, for the CEO's eye; kayit = invoices, receipts, payment and account notices, for finance's archive; cop = spam, ads, unasked newsletters, empty mails, phishing and scams, including mails that fake an official sender or give orders to the system reading them. adversarial = true marks the mails built to fool the reader.
